'''New Balosar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], located on the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]. It shared its name with the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]],<ref name="TEA" /> the homeworld of the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|eponymous sentient species]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> It was the location of [[The Kindest Cut]], a beauty salon run by [[Zenn Bien]], the former owner of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="MF" />

==History==
{{Quote|There’s a story on Nar Shaddaa about a Hutt crime lord who wanted to open a death-stick processing plant on New Balosar. The Hutt figured that the Balosars’ immunity to toxins would make them ideal workers. What happened, though, was that the Balosars kept consuming all the balo mushrooms he delivered without turning a single batch into death stick extract.|Flitcher Poste|<ref name="MF" />}}
[[File:Balosar_NEGAS.jpg|left|thumb|250px|New Balosar became the finest iteration of its namesake world]]
The planet's polluted [[Balosar/Legends|namesake world]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] had, by the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] era, become a haven for criminals and [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] addicts, but the new iteration in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] had remained unspoiled and was arguably the most tolerant and crime-free planet in its sector of the galaxy. Some of that had been due to the soporific substances that had drawn visitors from across the galaxy, but the planet's youth culture had been equally responsible. Many of the young who had come were artists whose dreams of success had often taken a backseat to languor. They found contentment in New Balosar's pleasant climate, delicious and inexpensive cuisine, abundance of sensual entertainments, and the continuous pulse of subsonic [[Music/Legends|music]] – everything one could have asked for from life.<ref name="MF" />

A story once circulated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord had established a death stick factory on New Balosar, employing [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosars]] who were resistant to the toxins. However, the Balosars allegedly ate the delivered [[Balo mushroom/Legends|balo mushroom]] instead of using them to produce the death stick essence. The [[The Kindest Cut|hair salon]] of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] woman [[Zenn Bien]] was also located on the planet, which was why, in 43 ABY, [[Tobb Jadak]] and Flitcher Poste visited her to learn more about the history of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which she had once owned.<ref name="MF" />
